review-cron-1.prompt:
Maintain only the Living Space with id review-space. Use spaces_* tools for all Space reads and writes. Do not change any other Space or write the Space database/files directly. First use spaces_get to check that this Space is not archived and its refresh grant is granted; stop without writes if either check fails. Use the tools available in your Hermes configuration to complete the task, respecting their permissions. Do not call spaces_refresh or change schedules. Preserve user notes, statuses and other user-owned fields. For retrieved/generated records, use spaces_write_records with source_owned=true and source metadata; never put upkeep results in user data. If source-owned writes are unavailable, report that limitation without overwriting user fields.

Upkeep task:
Update public demo records.
